access_body.invited: An invitation was sent; the parent has not chosen a password yet.

child_form.dietary_notes_hint: Optional. Shown on the kitchen's allergy sheet.
child_form.is_active_hint: An inactive child can no longer receive meals.
child_form.delete_body: {name} and their subscription periods will be permanently deleted. To keep the history, deactivate the child instead.

subscriptions.title: Subscription periods
subscriptions.description: Subscription meals can only be ordered during an active period. Periods cannot overlap.
subscriptions.delete_body: The subscription period will be deleted.
subscriptions.empty_body: This child has no subscription yet.
subscriptions.end_hint: Leave empty for an open-ended subscription.

import.title: Import families
import.instructions: One row per child. Rows with the same parent email are grouped under one parent. Re-importing the same file creates no duplicates: parents are matched by email, children by parent + first name + last name.
import.date_format: Dates as YYYY-MM-DD. parent_locale: fr or en (fr by default).
import.allergies_note: An import never removes an allergy: it only adds them.
import.preview_body: Nothing is saved until you confirm.
import.has_errors: Fix the errors in the file and import it again. No row is saved while errors remain.
import.nothing_to_do: Every row is already up to date.
import.send_invitations: Send the invitation to new parents
import.send_invitations_hint: {count, plural, =0 {No new parents.} one {# email will be sent.} other {# emails will be sent.}}
import.expired: This preview has expired. Please upload the file again.
import.no_longer_valid: The data changed since the preview: check the errors before confirming.
import.done: Import complete: {createdParents} parent(s) created, {updatedParents} updated, {createdChildren} child(ren) created, {updatedChildren} updated, {createdSubscriptions} period(s) created, {invited} invitation(s) sent.
import.invitation_failures: {count, plural, one {# invitation could not be sent} other {# invitations could not be sent}}. Resend them from the parent's record.
